answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The dawn holds work receipts rather than names, so the echo of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. The falcon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
